exposure: Chemotherapy for high-grade bone and soft tissue tumors
outcome: Fertility (ability to father or conceive offspring)
Interval between last chemotherapy and first delivery
Association between cumulative dose of chemotherapeutic agents and subsequent reproduction
cohort: 47 young adults (24 men and 23 women) who had survived for more than 5 years after receiving chemotherapy for high-grade bone and soft tissue tumors.
finding: Infertility occurred more frequently in men compared to women following intensive chemotherapy, and fertile men had received smaller cumulative doses of chemotherapeutic agents, particularly ifosfamide.
mod_finding: Of the 10 first births, 6 were normal transvaginal deliveries and 4 were caesarean sections.
